text: Parent/Engineering Director

I am in our schools every week, at drop-off and on field trips. Our son, 8, is a third grader at Oak, and our daughter, 5, just started kindergarten there. Our youngest will be in our schools until 2039. Every decision this board makes lands on my family's dinner table, and on yours.

California public schools educated me from kindergarten through UC Berkeley. Today I lead engineering organizations at GitHub after a decade doing the same at Google. I come prepared, ask hard questions, and explain trade-offs in plain language.

I am proud to be endorsed by the Los Altos Teachers Association. I will listen to parents, teachers, staff, and neighbors, and deliver responsible oversight with clear answers. I will ground curriculum in evidence, from science-based early literacy to thoughtful planning for Al, and strengthen enrollment by making the case for our schools to every new TK and kindergarten family.
Strong public schools educate children and weave neighborhoods into community. I would be honored to earn your vote.
Earlier this year I answered the board's questions, unscripted and on the record. That transparency is what I will bring as a trustee. Watch the full video at DavidPollForLASD.com

text: Governing Board Member, Los Altos School District

I have been active in the Los Altos School District community for twenty years, and have had the privilege of serving on the LASD Board of Trustees for the last ten, including two terms as Board President.

Over that time I have had thousands of conversations with parents, teachers, and community members, and I understand both what makes our schools so special and the urgent work required to ensure that they continue to thrive in the years to come.
During my time on the board I have worked to:
Increase the mental health resources available to our students, teachers, staff, and families.
Protect and reinforce our school communities as safe places for learning and as the vital centers of our neighborhoods.
Implement a financially responsible facilities plan which will provide improved learning environments for all students.
Promote transparency and open communication between the district, our parents, and the broader community.
My time on the board has shaped me into an effective, thoughtful advocate for our community as a whole, and with your support I look forward to continuing that work.

text: Governing Board Member/Business Owner

It has been my honor to serve the LASD community since I was first elected in 2018. As a former LASD parent, I've seen the impact of the strong education provided by LASD, and as your school board member, I've worked hard to ensure that every student receives an educational experience that prepares them for success in any path they choose. My guiding ethos has always been to keep students and families at the center of every decision, and I believe strongly in the whole child model: looking at improving education and wellness outcomes from a holistic perspective. I have the experience, insight, and proven commitment to improving outcomes for all youth, having worked on education issues at the district, county, and state levels. As LASD Board President in 2021, 2025, and 2026, I'm proud to have supported the partnership between district administration, teachers/staff, and families. In addition to serving on various nonprofit boards and the SCC Juvenile Justice Commission, I was president of the SCC School Boards Association and now represent the needs of our students and families at the state level through the CA School Boards Association. Please visit www.shalisirkay.com to learn more.

text: Attorney, Appointed Incumbent

LASD schools have always been part of my identity. I grew up in Los Altos and attended LASD schools. My mother also taught in LASD for many years. As an adult, I returned to Los Altos with my family so that our children could also attend LASD schools. My older daughter is a junior at MVHS and my younger one is an eighth grader at Blach.

Throughout their LASD journey, I have been deeply involved in their schools and with the district. I have served for 6 years on the PTA Boards of Springer and Blach─5 of those years as President. And I have played a meaningful role in forging an alliance between the Los Altos Educational Foundation (LAEF) and each of the PTA's that has blossomed into LASD Education Partners.

In those endeavors, my guiding principle has been making our schools and organizations work better for all LASD families, accentuating the attributes that make LASD great, and building consensus around how we want our schools to be.
In March, I was appointed to the LASD Board of Trustees. I now hope to continue my work with the Board in furtherance of my lifetime of dedication to LASD.
